content.title: Craving your daily dose of caffeine? Here's what to know about Starbucks Easter Hours
content.text: Spring is finally here! With the arrival of sunshine and warmer weather comes one of the biggest holidays of the year: Easter. This year, the Christian observance falls on Sunday, April 5. Whatever you've got planned to celebrate the day, whether it's gathering with loved ones for a traditional Easter dinner or coloring eggs with the kids, you may need an extra dose of caffeine or your favorite coffee drink to get you through it.If that's the case, you may be wondering if Starbucks is open on Easter. Given that many restaurants, businesses and retailers are closed in observance of the April holiday, TODAY.com reached out to the coffee roaster to find out if customers can expect stores and drive-thrus to be open this Sunday.See below for the most up-to-date information on Starbucks' Easter hours in 2026, as well as a list of restaurants that will be open for business this Easter to ensure that no matter what you've got on the calendar to mark the day, you can enjoy it with your favorite food or beverage on hand.Is Starbucks Open on Easter 2026? As is the case with a majority of holidays, many Starbucks locations will be open and ready to take your latte, coffee or tea orders on Easter this year. That said, some locations may be closed or have adjusted hours in observance of the holiday.According to a Starbucks representative, “Coffeehouse hours vary by location and they may occasionally adjust their hours based on business and customer needs.”Because of that, Starbucks recommends that customers confirm local hours ahead of going using either the Starbucks app or store locator. To check whether or not your local Starbucks is open this Easter, you'll find a store locator right here. Restaurants Open on Easter 2026See below for a list of restaurants that will be open on Sunday, April 5. Arby’s: Many Arby’s locations will be open, with varying hours. Find local hours here.Benihana: A majority of Benihana restaurants will be open. Confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here. Bob Evans: Restaurants will be open on Easter. Hours may vary by location. Find local hours here. Bonchon: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Burger King: Most Burger King restaurants will be open on Easter. Customers are encouraged to confirm hours ahead of going. Find local hours here. Chili’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Denny’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Dunkin’: Many Dunkin’ locations will be open on Easter. Customers are encouraged to confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here. Krispy Kreme: Most stores will be open, hours may vary by location. Find local hours here. McDonald’s: Most restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Wendy’s: Many locations will be open on Easter. Since hours can vary by location, customers should confirm hours before going. Find local hours here.
